shortDescription: implements rest api for global acl configuration

options.name: acl_action
options.description: Type of action acl rule will take, required when defining ACL rule.

options.name: acl_name
options.description: Name for acl policy being configured.

options.name: acl_source_address
options.description: source ip address for acl policy type standard i.e 192.168.0.1, used with acl_type=AT_STANDARD_IPV4

options.name: acl_source_mask
options.description: net mask for source acl_source_address in octet form i.e 255.255.255.0, used with acl_type=AT_STANDARD_IPV4

options.name: acl_type
options.description: Type of acl policy to be configured.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Configures (force) API version (vX.Y) for acces to the remote device.

options.name: destination_ip_address
options.description: Applies to destination IP Address/Subnet matching this extended acl filter, i.e 192.168.0.1. Used with acl_type=AT_EXTENDED_IPV4

options.name: destination_port
options.description: Dictionary of integer ports to match on. Applies to destination port matching this filter. Only PT_SCTP, PT_TCP and PT_UDP Protocol types destination source_port. Maximum value for port_range_end is 65525. Dictionary containing the keys 'port_not_equal','port_range_start', 'port_range_end' See below for examples. Used with acl_type=AT_EXTENDED_IPV4

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport. The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: icmp_code
options.description: Applies to icmp code matching this field. Only PT_ICMP protocol_type support icmp_code

options.name: icmp_type
options.description: Applies to icmp type matching this field. Only PT_ICMP protocol_type support icmp_code

options.name: igmp_type
options.description: Applies to igmp type matching this field. Only PT_IGMP protocol_type support igmp_type

options.name: is_connection_established
options.description: Match TCP packets of an established connection on ACL rule. Only PT_TCP protocol_type support is_connection_established

options.name: is_log
options.description: Enable/disable acl logging.

options.name: match_bit
options.description: The set of TCP match bits. Only PT_TCP protocol_type support match_bit. - MB_ACK Match TCP packets with the ACK bit set. - MB_FIN Match TCP packets with the FIN bit set - MB_RST Match TCP packets with the RST bit set - MB_SYN Match TCP packets with the SYN bit set

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: Specifies the port to use when building the connection to the remote device.

options.name: precedence
options.description: Match a specific IP precedence flag.

options.name: protocol_type
options.description: Protocol type for acl filter. Applicable for extended acl.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: remark
options.description: Description for acl policy

options.name: sequence_no
options.description: Sequence number for the ACL rule to be configured

options.name: source_ip_address
options.description: Applies to source IP Address matching this extended acl filter, i.e 192.168.0.1. Used with acl_type=AT_EXTENDED_IPV4

options.name: source_ip_mask
options.description: Net mask source_ip_address in octet form i.e 255.255.255.0. Used with acl_type=AT_EXTENDED_IPV4

options.name: source_port
options.description: Dictionary of ports to match on. Applies to source port matching this filter. Only PT_SCTP, PT_TCP and PT_UDP Protocol types support source_port. Maximum value for port_range_end is 65525. Dictionary containing the keys 'port_not_equal','port_range_start', 'port_range_end'. See below for examples. Used with acl_type=AT_EXTENDED_IPV4

options.name: ssh_keyfile
options.description: Specifies the SSH key to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is the path to the key used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_SSH_KEYFILE will be used instead.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or deletes acl policy.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Specifies the timeout in seconds for communicating with the network device for either connecting or sending commands. If the timeout is exceeded before the operation is completed, the module will error.

options.name: tos
options.description: Match a specific IP type of service flag - Tos value

options.name: use_ssl
options.description: Configures use SSL (HTTPS) for access to the remote device.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. This value is used to authenticate the SSH session. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Configures validation of certification for access to the remote device.
